title: The Home page, next version — round 2, eighth look

steps.headline: The volume bar is now about twice as tall, with a bigger speaker icon inside it.
steps.changed: Your note on the last look: it was meant to be taller and was not — an older height setting further down the page was winning. Now the bar is 30 pixels tall with rounded ends, the − and + are smaller beside it, and the speaker shows the level.
steps.notice: Dragging works the same; the whole bar is easier to grab.
steps.risk: Brightness bars on lights keep their thinner size; say if you want them to match.
